about: GlassNet predictions for stage 01's oxide bench. Temperatures °C; T0..T12 are where log10 η [Pa·s] = 0..12; liquidus is the temperature above which no crystal is stable; nd, vd, rho are index, Abbe number and density (g/cm³). `surrogate` is a cubic in mol% fitted to GlassNet over batches the bench's sliders can make (silica the balance), with its own error against GlassNet. `named` is GlassNet itself at each preset. `melts` keys the glasses of public/data/sciglass/bench.json: [split, GlassNet T at each of that glass's measured viscosity levels, liquidus, nd, vd], each null where SciGlass has no measurement to compare; split is t (in GlassNet's training set), h (its holdout) or n (found in neither).

model.name: GlassNet
model.cite: Cassar D.R., GlassNet: A multitask deep neural network for predicting many glass properties, Ceramics International 49 (2023) 36013–36024, doi:10.1016/j.ceramint.2023.08.281
model.license: Numbers computed with GlassPy (GPL-3.0-or-later); no GlassPy code or weights are included. Compositions from the bench and from SciGlass (ODbL 1.0).
